safe: Dis scrap dey safe to touch

hazards.corrosive_acid: Dis material get acid wey fit burn you skin. No touch am with bare hand.
hazards.lead_poisoning: Dis one get lead wey bad for body. No break am, no breathe the dust.
hazards.mercury_exposure: Get mercury inside wey dey poison you. No touch if e don burst.
hazards.lithium_fire_risk: Na lithium battery. E fit catch fire if e spoil. No put am for water.
hazards.cadmium_toxicity: E contain cadmium wey fit spoil your kidney and bone. No breathe smoke from am.
hazards.asbestos_fibers: Dis one get asbestos. No blow the dust because e fit spoil your lung.
hazards.hydrocarbon_contamination: Get oil or fuel inside. No bring fire near am.
hazards.sharp_edges: Dis scrap get sharp corner wey fit cut you. Handle am with care.
hazards.explosive_gas: E fit release gas wey go explode. Keep am far from fire.
hazards.chemical_burns: Na chemical wey fit burn your skin. Wear hand glove before you touch.
hazards.arsenic_compound: Get arsenic wey dey poison body. No chop or drink after you touch am.
hazards.chromium_contamination: Get chromium wey fit enter your blood. No touch your eye when handling.
hazards.refrigerant_gas: Get cooling gas wey dey bad for your breathing. No breathe am.
hazards.pcb_contamination: E get PCB wey fit cause cancer. No burn am for fire.
hazards.biological_waste: Na dirty waste from house or hospital. Wear glove before you handle.

safety_instructions.default: Wear hand glove before you touch. Wash your hand well after work.
safety_instructions.acid: Wear glove and goggles. If acid touch your skin, wash with water and soap quick quick.
safety_instructions.lead: No break or burn dis material. Keep the dust far from your mouth.
safety_instructions.lithium: No put am for water. Keep am for dry place where sun no reach.
safety_instructions.mercury: No touch am at all. Call person wey sabi handle am now now.
safety_instructions.asbestos: No blow the dust. Make you wet am before you move am.
safety_instructions.sharp: Use thick glove. Be careful of the sharp edges.
safety_instructions.general: Dis material no get wahala. But still wash your hand after you touch am.
